text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "Dear Mom, how are you doing?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I'm having a great time!
Each day is filled
with so much excitement,
it's almost hard
to keep up."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"We had a triathlon at the academy
recently, and can you believe it? I
entered
the competition!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"It was sooooo much fun! But it's all the
other competitors that
impressed me the
most. They were amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The older racers gave me lots of courage.
Just like them, I want to
inspire others with
my running.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Also, I want to keep running with
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Just announced—the Tracen Academy
Team Triathlon"...
We're having a
triathlon?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know the school held triathlons
for us! It looks like this one is
sponsored by a
sporting goods manufacturer to celebrate
their anniversary.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It says they're accepting entries now!
It's
four people per team, so...
Dia, that means
we can enter together!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I was just about to say that!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I've always wanted to enter one of the
academy's events! And since
this one's an
anniversary,
it has a fun festival feel to it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like the festival lover in you is
already getting excited!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I guess so! But you're pretty full of
enthusiasm yourself!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Come on, we have teammates to
find!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's start by asking around class!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"There are three disciplines in the
triathlon—swimming, cycling, and running.
In Tracen's triathlon,
running is split into two segments,
making for a four-person
relay." Sounds fun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that sounds like the perfect event
for a multi-talented athlete
like you. Will
you participate?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Definitely! I can already feel my muscles
getting fired up for it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, then we mustn't let their excitement
go to waste! Would you
allow me to join
your team?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You wanna join me?! Yeah, please do!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I, Mejiro Bright,
will make every
effort to be a useful
member of your team!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Let's make sure we win this, dear Sister!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you sound even more pumped than I
am! All right, let's do this,
Bright!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Let's see...
"Triathlon entry requirements"...
Oh, they have special rules. "Kickboard
use is permitted." "The first running
segment involves a mission."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Details of the mission will be announced
on the day of the event"?
That sounds like
fun! Think I'll scout out some more
info. ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"First-place and honorary winners will
receive prizes from the sporting goods
company." The grand prize is...
a buffet at
a luxury hotel?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Buffet means... all you can eat, right?! Drool.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It says here the triathlon will be
broadcast
on TV! You interested,
Ayabe?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Not in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Well that was blunt... I'd expect nothing
less from you though!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think it could be interesting
though? We could team up with racers
from other distances who we usually
wouldn't get a chance
to run with!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Are you going to enter?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Well,
I am interested... but I'd like to
think on it before I make a
decision!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In this spectacular anniversary event, I
must take to the stage for the
sake of
Tracen Academy's honor!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention for the sake of the
producers of the various garments that
adorn my body on a daily basis! Let the
Overlord perform the
greatest show of all!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You're even thinking of the academy and
the sports company. Wow,
you're amazing,
Opera O!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha! It comes naturally to the
Overlord! Now, let us assemble our
cast
right away!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hm... "Display the fruits of your daily
training and make this event a
thrilling
success worthy of Tracen Academy!
—Director Akikawa"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh! As the class rep, this is where I must
step up! I'll take the initiative
to enter so
the event gains popularity!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I have received the director's
instructions
loud and clear! I know what
I must
do—swap out all the bicycles for crayfish!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No, I should just jump into the sea and
become a whirlpool! Where's
the most
interesting team? Come on out!
